instruction: Make every slide in this presentation have a green background.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Variation 1: Change all slide backgrounds to green color (RGB: 0, 255, 0). Uses existing evaluate_presentation_fill_to_rgb_distance metric which calculates the distance between actual and expected RGB values. The evaluator checks if all slides have green background instead of the original white background. No custom functions needed as we reuse existing evaluator logic.
metadata.verification: Reuses existing metric function evaluate_presentation_fill_to_rgb_distance from slides.py. The function calculates RGB distance for all slides and returns similarity score. This variation targets green (0,255,0).
